subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw commit a root Microsoft tracker plus generator, or keep this tracker as PR-body/admin metadata until a maintainer sponsors the repo tool shape?
rationale: The remaining defects are concrete, but the durable product choice is whether this broad live GitHub tracker should become a repository artifact and maintainer automation surface at all.

options.title: Repair before considering merge
options.body: Keep the PR open as a draft and require the generator safety fixes, check mode, no changelog edit, merge-conflict refresh, and redacted real behavior proof before revisiting merge.

options.title: Keep as PR-body tracker only
options.body: Use this PR as the living tracker thread and close or abandon the committed root file/generator path.

options.title: Move to separate maintained automation
options.body: Replace this branch with a smaller maintainer-owned script or external report that has explicit ownership and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Repair before considering merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open as a draft and require the generator safety fixes, check mode, no changelog edit, merge-conflict refresh, and redacted real behavior proof before revisiting merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available routing candidate for repository admin/tooling direction from recent script/admin history and ownership-rule context.
